rationale: The position was entered on a momentum reclaim of $75.00, but the price has immediately failed to hold that level and is drifting back toward the daily low of $74.50. With the broader market (SPY) showing weakness and the stock trading well below both the 9-EMA and VWAP, the mean-reversion thesis is invalidated by the lack of immediate follow-through. Exiting now preserves capital before a potential test of the $74.50 support level.
